title: GenAI as an 'Invisible Hand' in Opinion Dynamics: Evidence from a Group-Level Simulation Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.37689v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent arguments suggest that genAI can act as an invisible hand that gradually shapes social structures, such as collective beliefs and norms. The argument is that if millions of people repeatedly consult genAI tools, their generated outcomes quietly shape what becomes acceptable, reasonable or conventional. We study this in the context of collective opinion dynamics, i.e., how groups form opinions around controversial dynamics. We present the findings of a simulation including 50,000 group discussions across 50 controversial statements, three LLMs, and different social configurations. We vary two characteristics of LLM interaction-agreeableness and personalization-and compare the influence of genAI in homogeneous and heterogeneous groups. translated_title: 生成式AI作为舆论动态中的“看不见的手”：来自群体层面模拟研究的证据
translated_abstract: 近期有观点认为，生成式AI（genAI）可以充当一只“看不见的手”，逐渐塑造社会结构，如集体信念和规范。其论点是：如果数百万人反复咨询生成式AI工具，其生成结果会悄然塑造何为可接受、合理或常规的观念。我们在集体舆论动态的背景下研究这一问题，即群体如何围绕有争议的话题形成意见。我们展示了一项大规模模拟研究的发现，该模拟涵盖50个争议性陈述下的50,000次群体讨论、三个大语言模型（LLM）以及不同的社会配置。我们改变了LLM交互的两个特征——迎合性（agreeableness）和个性化，并比较了生成式AI在同质群体与异质群体中的影响。研究结果表明，当模型采取非中立立场（即表示同意或不同意用户）时，针对用户画像的个性化会增加LLM的影响力。此外，我们发现……
tldr: 该研究通过涵盖50个争议话题、5万次群体讨论的大规模模拟发现，当大语言模型采取非中立立场时，针对用户画像的个性化设置会显著增强生成式AI对群体舆论形成的隐性塑造作用。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale simulation of 50,000 group discussions across 50 controversial statements, this study reveals that profile-specific personalization amplifies LLM influence on collective opinion formation when models adopt non-neutral stances.
